title: Orthodontic Benefit Riders Claims Manual — Covered Months Under the New Orthodontist's Plan
content:
**Orthodontic Benefit Riders: the plan of the practice now treating the patient.** For the recognised covered-treatment fee, the covered months from the month of the latest move follow the plan of the practice now treating the patient. That plan is compared with the months the new-start plan still had after the move, which are the planned treatment months less the whole calendar months from the banding date to the date of the latest transfer entry.

| Months remaining on the latest transfer entry, compared with the months the new-start plan still had after the move | Covered months from the month of the latest move |
|---|---|
| fewer | no more of them are counted than the months remaining on that entry |
| more | counted in full, but valued at the share that the months the new-start plan still had after the move form of the months remaining on that entry, because longer treatment adds no benefit |
| equal | counted in full, at full value |

A case whose latest transfer entry has no months remaining is treated as a case that has not moved for the plan of the practice now treating the patient. For such a case, and for a case without a transfer entry, this rule does not apply.

A calendar month counts as whole only when the day of the month of the transfer entry's date is on or after the day of the month of the banding date.

## Hypothetical case

The inputs: 25 planned months, banding on 10 January, and the latest transfer entry dated 22 August of the same year. That gives 7 whole months, so the new-start plan still had 18 months after the move.

| Months remaining on the transfer entry | Effect on the covered months from the move month |
|---|---|
| 15 | at most 15 of them are counted |
| 24 | counted in full, valued at 18 of 24, that is three quarters |
| 18 | counted in full, at full value |
